title: FIELDWISE ATK-hosted baseline: full adoption of the Consolidated Partner Review Pack of 2026-08-28, the evidence regime, the effort figures and the run identity
context: The 2026 MSCA-PF call bars resubmission by the same recruiting organisation and researcher after a sub-80% 2025 score; PLANTDIGISENSE (ELTE + the same researcher) scored 70.40% per the CV. The operator decided the host switch and the Krumatic accession on 2026-08-26 and consolidated the scientific concept with the partners in the Review Pack of 2026-08-28. This entry records the operator rulings that turned that material into the fieldwise-run-02 Tier 3 baseline.

operator_rulings.question: Target document for the completed open-decisions record
operator_rulings.ruling: Canonical FIELDWISE_open_decisions.docx content (with the PIC ruling and 08-26 annotations) is the base; the completed version overwrites plans/reports/FIELDWISE_open_decisions_updated_2026-08-26.docx, which becomes the single completed record.

operator_rulings.question: Tier 3 scope
operator_rulings.ruling: FULL PACK ADOPTION: the Consolidated Partner Review Pack of 2026-08-28 supersedes the prior concept wholesale — new title/framing, WP1-WP5 restructure, unnamed commercial-farmer validation site, Szentendre Skanzen contingency, MVCRI post-MSCA-only, DrR background/IP doctrine, Krumatic development-from-M1, mainly-remote placement, teaching route via MATE + AU Plovdiv, Janda at ATK, Varga at ELTE.

operator_rulings.question: Evidence regime
operator_rulings.ruling: Split: registry-verifiable and partner-authored factual content is Confirmed against the committed sources (both input files committed under source_materials/consolidated_pack_2026-08-28/); forward-looking commitments not yet in partner writing are operator-declared Assumed with declarations in working_assumptions.json. Nothing is Unresolved.

operator_rulings.question: Partner effort table
operator_rulings.ruling: Role-for-role swap: supervisor (Hollós/ATK) 2.5 PM, co-supervisor (Jung/ELTE) 2.0 PM, AgroVIR 3.0, MATE 2.4, Krumatic 1.5 (top of its proposed 1.0-1.5 range, reflecting the expanded role), MVCRI removed, fellow 30 PM firm. Partner total 11.4.

operator_rulings.question: Switch evidence gates
operator_rulings.ruling: PLANTDIGISENSE score (70.40%, CV-sourced) and the resubmission-bar reading (new recruiting organisation releases the bar; associated partner does not re-trigger it) are operator-declared Assumed pending the ESR and the NCP/REA answer. ATK PIC 866599553 is Confirmed on CORDIS.

operator_rulings.question: Farmer site identity
operator_rulings.ruling: Recorded UNNAMED, exactly as the Pack does: an independent commercial farmer in Hungary, a collaborating validation environment, not a partner. Written access, sensor installation and treatment responsibilities are declared Assumed (key farmer_field_access) pending the T3.1 arrangement.

operator_rulings.question: Run identity
operator_rulings.ruling: New branch fieldwise-run-02, new run_id fieldwise-run-02 for all nodes; the existing phase8_checkpoint.json and validated checkpoint states are archived before the rerun touches Tier 4.

operator_rulings.question: Session end state
operator_rulings.ruling: Execute through Phase 8: after transcription and pre-flight, drive the DAG run to the assembled new draft, fixing gate failures at their inputs, never fabricating past a gate.

operator_rulings.question: Fellow per-WP person-month split (the Pack states none)
operator_rulings.ruling: Science-weighted split: WP1 3.0, WP2 6.0, WP3 6.6, WP4 6.0, WP5 5.4, cross-cutting 3.0 — total 30.0. Placement window M25-M30 = 5.4 + 0.6 cross-cutting = exactly 1.0 FTE.

operator_rulings.question: Governance calendar re-anchoring
operator_rulings.ruling: Steering points track the Pack's milestone months — M6, M14, M18, M24 — plus the retained M27 mid-placement review; Career Development Plan reviewed at the same five points; K11 re-targeted accordingly.

citation_scheme: Tier 3 records cite 'Pack §N' (the Review Pack's own section numbers; 'Pack A'..'Pack E' for its front-matter sections; 'Stage N' for the §1.2 methodology stages) and 'DI item N' / 'DI lines N-M' (decision_inputs_2026-08.md). Committed sources: docs/tier3_project_instantiation/source_materials/consolidated_pack_2026-08-28/. The prior hand_lift_provenance.json paragraph scheme applies only to the superseded Master Draft lifts and is not used by run-02 records.
kpi_reanchoring: K1-K11 re-anchored to the Pack deliverable set (impacts.json), preserving the accepted discipline (each KPI measures something the project controls and delivers; no advance numeric water-saving promises). K11 keeps the CDP target with the new five review points.
